Existing world: 3 AUTH, 1 DB, 1 original Phone. Start from previous scene end pose. All beat positions derive ONLY from a real selected ElevenLabs character-aligned recording, never editorial clock estimates.

1. At spoken phrase "Stopping retries helps": Hold the unchanged map and visualize 900 arrival/s versus ~500 lookup/s as brief voice-synced orange labels outside nodes.
2. At spoken phrase "So we add admission control": Attach admission policy indication to existing Gateway/Auth entry, not a new service or server.
3. At spoken phrase "Because we have three Auth instances": One shared budget across ALL THREE Auth instances; show illustrative 450 total DB lookup attempts/s INCLUDING retries.
4. At spoken phrase "When demand exceeds that budget": One Phone shows a fast explicit shed/rejected NEW Login; cannot create session; don't hide user failure.
5. At spoken phrase "We also limit concurrent lookups": Focus existing 3×8 per-server pool max slots, constrain total concurrent lookups globally. Add restrained retry bulkhead label.

7. At spoken phrase "Here is the trade-off": Accepted Login requests have a chance to finish, shed users fail fast; DB capacity remains 500/s illustrative.
